resources.string: "This chat's agent has no Jarvis tools yet. Tap to add the Jarvis MCP server (Settings → Jarvis → Setup)."
"No mission yet. Ask for something big (\"build the settings screen, test it and don't stop until it works\"): Jarvis writes the plan here and works through it."
"Give me a big job. I write the plan, put together teams of agents, hand out the work in parallel, check what comes back and keep going until it's done."
"Applies from the next time the microphone opens"
"Chat only: open the Jarvis tab in the chat list and tap “New Jarvis chat”. Pick its agent and model like in any chat."
"The Jarvis chats you opened yourself (New Jarvis chat) also show in All and the agent tabs; the voice chats Jarvis opens by itself stay under Jarvis."
"Every Jarvis chat, the voice chats Jarvis opens by itself too, also shows in All and the agent tabs."
"Jarvis chats are listed only under the Jarvis tab. The work chats Jarvis starts for its tasks are normal chats and always show in All."
"Pick the agent Jarvis talks to. Nothing is selected yet, so Jarvis can't answer."
"%1$s is turned off in Settings → Agents: turn it on, or pick another agent here."
"e.g. Call me Santosh. Reply in Hinglish. I mostly work on the antigem project."
"Pick the agent Jarvis talks to first (Settings → Jarvis → Agent)."
"Jarvis reported that its app tools are missing in %1$s. Add the Jarvis MCP server below (then start a fresh Jarvis chat)."
"With hands-free on: one press talks (or sends), two presses stop. Works while no music app holds the button."
"Quick Settings tile: pull down the notification shade, edit the tiles and add “Jarvis” to talk from anywhere with one tap."
"You can always send with the Send button on the card, the headset button or the notification's Send."
"Off: nothing is sent while you take a break to think. Say a send phrase or tap Send when you're done."
"Sent after a fixed pause. A bar on the card fills while it counts down; tap Wait to keep talking."
"Jarvis waits longer when you sound unfinished (“…and”, “…the”) and less for short answers. Tap Wait to keep talking."
"When Jarvis just asked you something, your answer is sent after the pause above, even with auto send off."
"Answers are sent exactly like everything else. The send mode is fixed when the microphone opens and never changes while you talk."
"End with one of these and it is sent at once (the phrase itself is not sent)."
"End with one of these and nothing is sent."
"After Jarvis speaks, listen for your reply"
"The microphone opens after every answer while you are talking to Jarvis."
"The microphone only opens when you tap or wake Jarvis (and when it asks you something it needs right away)."
"Jarvis decides: after “Done, want me to run it?” the microphone opens; after “Saved the file.” it does not. Questions always open it."
"If you say nothing at all in this time, the microphone closes with a soft tone."
"During follow-up listening Jarvis only reacts when you say its name (or answer its question)."
"During follow-up listening Jarvis ignores what was clearly said to someone else, and filler like “um”."
"Only a message that starts with one of your interrupt phrases (Voice shortcuts below) stops Jarvis' work; anything else waits."
"Tones when the microphone opens and closes"
"“This device” uses Android's recognizer and needs no sign-in. If the agent's dictation fails, Jarvis switches to the device for the rest of the session."
"Jarvis shows its answers on the card instead of saying them (meetings, night). Also in quick settings (tune icon)."
"If the online voice fails, Jarvis falls back to this device's voice."
"Jarvis says a short line while a long step runs."
"You can also say “speak slower”, “faster” or “repeat that”: Jarvis handles those at once, without asking the model."
"When a task finishes, fails or gets stuck"
"Jarvis reads the result, tells you the gist and follows up (asks you, passes answers on). Uses a model turn per event."
"Jarvis just announces it (“Release build is done”), without a model turn."
"Jarvis approves what clearly serves the task's goal and asks you about anything risky or unclear (needs “Jarvis decides” above)."
"Approvals follow “Approvals by voice” below: approved automatically or read out to you."
"Report a task with no progress after"
"“<chat title> is done. Please check it.” for chats that are not Jarvis tasks."
"Not for the chat I'm looking at"
"Also read the start of the reply"
"Warn when the 5-hour usage is almost gone"
"Once per window, at about 15% left (Claude Code)."
"Read replies out loud in new Jarvis chats"
"Each chat has its own Voice switch on its strip; this is the default for new ones."
"When Jarvis sleeps or polls while waiting for its tasks"
"A turn that waits (sleep, wait loops, wake-up timers) is stopped once news is waiting, or after 12 seconds while its tasks run; the news goes in at once."
"The next message tells it not to wait; the news still waits until its turn ends."
"No guard: news waits until Jarvis ends its turn by itself."
"Whatever comes in meanwhile, and everything that finished while Jarvis was busy, goes to it together in one message."
"With autopilot on, Jarvis is nudged to continue whenever it stops while the mission is unfinished and nothing runs. Nudges in a row without progress pause it."
"Whether Jarvis chats also show in All: Settings → Jarvis, “Jarvis chats in the chat list”."
"Several Jarvis chats can work at the same time. Each one runs and hears about only its own tasks; they never steer each other's work."
"Agents will run commands, edit files and delete things without asking, including by mistake. Only choose this if you accept that."
"“While it's active”: while Jarvis listens, works or speaks, or a task runs. Running chats of both agents keep the screen on anyway."
"Drag the orb anywhere: it rests on the nearest edge. “Hidden” shows it only while Jarvis is active (use the tile, headset or wake phrase)."
"A slim status line (“Checking the build…”) while it works."
"Screen, project, chat on screen, tasks, approvals and timers, so Jarvis rarely has to look them up."
"Start a fresh chat after idle time"
"Start a fresh chat after this many messages"
"A new chat starts with the Jarvis memory note and the last lines of the old conversation."
"Add a word or a whole sentence"
"The next message starts a new Jarvis chat"
